messages:
jessica (support): Incoming CS escalation from APAC customer: real-time inference p99 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.6s around 2026-02-18 03:10 UTC. They see auth token refresh errors + burst of retries. They provided sample trace and spike graphs.
jessica (support): attaching their trace: 503s on /v1/realtime/generate, repeated 3x per user-request. They say it coincided with a maintenance window yesterday (driver/firmware rollout).
devin (sre): looking at APAC realtime fleet dashboards now. I can see a correlated spike in request rate + 401/429 from auth service at 03:09–03:14 UTC. p99 lines up with auth retry storms.
alan_infra: we rolled CUDA+driver packages to apac-realtime pool at 02:45 UTC with firmware microcode bump at 02:58. I pushed a config that bumped connection timeout to upstream auth last week — wondering if retry backoff changed in the client lib.
cam_research: customer logs show repeated header: "Authorization: Bearer <token>" followed by 401 then immediate client retry, 0.2s apart, 3 retries. They do not respect jitter/backoff.
jessica (support): customer is on our Dedicated APAC cohort with regional auth proxy. They reported billing spikes too — retries are doubling token usage and duplicate generation calls. They want immediate mitigation.
devin (sre): mitigation idea 1: quickly add server-side idempotency filter at edge to dedupe identical requests within 1s window (cheap). Mitigation idea 2: force auth proxy to return 429 with Retry-After instead of 401 to ensure clients back off.
alan_infra: 1s dedupe is reasonable; but storage burst from duplicate requests is causing NVMe queue depth to jump on some nodes, which increases hostfs tail latency and pushes p99 up further. Need to address both sides.
ops-bot: [deploy] started: hotfix/idempotency-filter-apac on edge-proxy group (deploy_id: 2026-02-18-17).
ops-bot: [deploy] success: hotfix/idempotency-filter-apac rolled to 12/12 edge proxies in APAC in ~3m.
devin (sre): deployed idempotency filter. Early signs: duplicate generation rate down ~78% over next 60s, p95 improved but p99 still at ~900ms on some tail hosts.
cam_research: ran sampling on KV-cache hit metrics — prefix caching dropped during spike (cache thrash). I see many short-lived keys from duplicate requests evicting hot prefixes.
alan_infra: increasing GPU driver queueing doesn't help if host I/O is saturated. I'm going to temporarily throttle client-facing concurrency to the affected hosts (reduce max inflight requests per host by 40%) and route new sessions to eu nodes until we can stabilize.
jessica (support): customer notified about temporary routing to EU and idempotency fix; they accepted fallback.
devin (sre): routing policy updated; traffic shift completed. p99 for APAC pool down to ~320ms after routing and dedupe. Still seeing occasional host p99 spikes at 600–800ms due to NVMe qdepth bursts.
alan_infra: root cause hypothesis: combo of (a) firmware+driver change slightly changed IO ordering and increased write amplification for small-append patterns, and (b) auth retry storm generated large number of near-duplicate short-lived model runs which evicted prefix caches and amplified IO.
cam_research: repro steps for infra team: 1) apply driver+firmware on a staging host; 2) run scripted auth-retry generator (attached snippet) that issues 10k requests with no jitter, 3 retries immediate; 3) observe KV-cache miss rate and nvme qdepth. Snippet: ```python
# naive retry flood
for i in range(10000):
  r = requests.post(url, headers=bad_auth)  # expect 401
  if r.status_code==401:
    for _ in range(3):
      requests.post(url, headers=good_auth)
```
alan_infra: plan: 1) tune driver/firmware IO scheduler knobs on affected hosts to favor small read latency; 2) backport small batching + prefix cache reservation to prevent eviction from tiny runs; 3) push client library guidance to add jittered exponential backoff on 401; 4) consider rolling back firmware if we see reproducible IO regression in staging.
devin (sre): short-term fixes we did: idempotency filter, reduce per-host concurrency, route to EU. Medium-term actions: driver/firmware bisect on staging, KV cache reservation, and auth proxy behavior change. Long-term: add adaptive retry-limiter (server side) that rate-limits clients who cause retry storms.
jessica (support): opening CS follow-up with customer: summary of actions + ETA for medium-term fixes. They want billing adjustment for duplicate tokens consumed; looping in billing-bot.
billing-bot: noted: creating ticket BILL-APAC-142 for customer token-dup billing review.
ops-bot: [incident] incident created: INC-2026-APAC-RETRY-STORM (severity: high).
cam_research: tagging this thread for eng-runtime + eng-infra postmortem coordination.
alan_infra: I'll schedule driver bisect tomorrow 08:00 UTC and run the auth-flood repro. Will report results in this thread.
devin (sre): good. until bisect complete we should keep idempotency filter and per-host concurrency limits enabled in APAC.
jessica (support): thanks team — keeping customer updated. :thumbsup:
